notes.note: Searching a member number with no match shows exactly: "No member records matched your search." on the MEMBER INQUIRY / SELECTION screen (URL /members?by=number&q=...). This is a legitimate business result, not a failure.

Sign-on as super1 at branch MAIN-001 succeeds and lands on /menu showing "Signed on as S. VISOR (SUPERVISOR)". Member 100987 ([REDACTED:SECRET]) opens at /members/100987 with 15 shares; share 100987-S0001 already shows status HOLD [HOLD], which suggests placing a further hold on it may itself produce a warning screen.

The "Place Account Hold" link in the ACTIONS panel of the MEMBER RECORD screen is classified irreversible by policy and cannot be clicked by an automated run. The hold flow (share selection, reason code, notes, Continue, and the CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD screen carrying the IRREVERSIBLE ACTION banner) therefore could not be observed, so no capability can be recorded for it without a human decision.
